scope: Local qualification of prompt prerequisites needed to preserve live N3/N5 behavior during the coordinated runtime upgrade; no production change yet.

swi-prolog-node.mode: required for startup, tests and container builds

trealla-port.mode: required for optional Trealla N5 builds

fixes: Appendix B correlated prompt envelope and respond/3, one-use wire replies and HTTP session ownership.
Source-less HTTP calls execute through the existing private-module runtime dispatcher, preserving assertions across calls and Abort without leaking between sessions.
Private HTTP requests avoid browser alias routing; live local actor PIDs bypass legacy browser-capability lookup, removing the observed lock inversion during Reply/Abort/Halt races.

pinned_consumer.trealla_manifest_updated_after_run: Final Trealla pin validated separately with exact source/engine checks and pin regressions.

validation.linux_full_protocol_suite: all shared HTTP, WebSocket, newline, ownership and profile-boundary checks passed

http_output_followup.counterfactual: The old serializer fails the focused unit regression and closes the HTTP connection during the full Chrome example. The fix uses the current runtime output envelope, matching native SWI.

diagnostics: The initial 67764bc container candidates lacked the prompt prerequisites already present on the live nodes; no rollout was attempted.
The older preview baseline and the initial extracted Trealla candidate both reproduced a Reply/Abort/Halt hang on macOS and Linux. The lock trace identified browser-capability and HTTP-route locks.

After the lock fixes, 200 macOS rounds passed. A Linux run during parallel qualification exceeded the unchanged 2.5-second probe deadline after 188 successful rounds, without the earlier node-wide hang. An isolated timing-instrumented Linux run then passed all 200 rounds without any timeout or request error.

The full staged Chrome HTTP example additionally exposed an orphaned Trealla serializer call to an unmerged stream helper. Removing that call and matching the current runtime output envelope fixed the example. PT-022 now covers its output/read/repeat path.
deployment_status: Not deployed. Runtime containers passed staging; publication and configuration-policy checks precede production rollout.

deployment_configuration.n5_load_uri_origins: Retains the live N2–N5 allowlist, including N3.
deployment_configuration.peer_transport: Optional external-volume overlays recovered unchanged from the protected preview branch; named credential volumes remain read-only.
deployment_configuration.operator_values: No credentials or operator environment values are committed.
